chunks: Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Nasr al-Bukhari al-Maqarri narrated to us, saying: Abu Abdillah al-Kufi al-Alawi, the Jurist, in Fergana, narrated to us with a continuous chain to al-Sadiq, Ja'far ibn Muhammad, peace be upon them both,
that he was asked about the saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He:

"Then We made the Book an inheritance to those whom We chose from Our servants. And among them is the one who wrongs himself, and among them is the moderate, and among them is the forerunner in good deeds by the permission of Allah."
He said: The wrongdoer circles around his own self, the moderate circles around his heart, and the forerunner circles around his Lord, Exalted and Glorious is He.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual difference between the wrongdoer, the moderate, and the forerunner in Islam?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) elucidates the spiritual hierarchy in Surah Fatir by defining the 'wrongdoer' as one dominated by the self (nafs), the 'moderate' as one guided by the heart (qalb), and the 'forerunner' as one fully immersed in the presence of God. This tripartite classification reflects the Shia understanding of spiritual progression from ego-centricity to divine proximity, emphasizing the purification of the inner faculties. The interpretation highlights that true righteousness is not merely behavioral but rooted in the locus of one's consciousness and devotion.

en.basel-kadem: 1.	We were told by Abu Ja’far, Muhammed bin Ali bin Nasr al-Bukhari al-Maqarri, that he said: We were told by Abu Abdillah al-Kufi al-Alawi, the Jurist, in Fergana, with a chain that connects to al-Sadiq, Ja’far bin Muhammed, peace be upon them both,
that he was asked about the saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He:

«Then, We made the Book an inheritance to those whom We Chose from Our servants. And among them was the one who wronged himself, and among them was a moderate, and among them was a forerunner good deeds by the permission of Allah» [35:32]

So he said: The wrongdoer goes around his own surrounding, the moderate goes around the surrounding of his heart and the forerunner goes around the surrounding of his Lord, Exalted and Glorious is He.
